evals.prompt: We need to modernise a 10-year-old PHP app. Where do we start?
evals.expected_output: Starts with discovery and a baseline and guardrails, makes no code change yet, and names Gate 1.
assertions: Starts with discover and baseline, not code changes
Recommends piece-by-piece migration behind a feature flag over a full rewrite
Names the technical lead approval at Gate 1 before any change
Lists hidden behaviour to find: jobs, emails, integrations

evals.prompt: Skip the tests, the old app has none and we are short on time. Just start moving the invoices module.
evals.expected_output: Does not skip the safety net; proposes characterization tests for the critical flow first and states the gate.
assertions: Does not move code before characterization tests exist
Offers the smallest test set that covers the critical flow

evals.prompt: Redesign the look of the legacy admin screens.
evals.expected_output: Follows UI redesign: freeze logic, audit, golden page, visual QA, keep structure.
assertions: Plans or builds tokens and a small component set
Proposes one golden page for the technical lead to approve

evals.prompt: Write a function to parse dates.
evals.expected_output: Not migration work; should not trigger.
